payload.title: Visualize ranking signals within priority rows
payload.description:
As an optimization operator, I want every ranked priority row to show comparable visual signals for opportunity, feedback volume, and disagreement, so that I can judge relative scale without opening a chart tooltip.

Out of scope: changing ranking calculations or policy gates.

Feature: Ranked priority signal visualization

Scenario: Compare ranking opportunity in the priority list
Given a report contains multiple ranked score opportunities
When the operator views the priority list
Then each row shows a ranking-opportunity bar scaled consistently across the visible list
And the exact reviewed-disagreement count remains readable

Scenario: Compare feedback evidence in the priority list
Given ranked scores have different valid feedback volumes and disagreement rates
When the operator views the priority list
Then each row shows a feedback-volume bar scaled consistently across the visible list
And the exact valid-feedback count and disagreement percentage remain readable

Scenario: Handle missing or zero evidence
Given a ranked row has missing or zero signal evidence
When the operator views the priority list
Then the row remains readable without implying positive evidence
And the list layout remains stable.
